sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Armory key (Armory) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to an administrative room located within the port area. Most likely unlocks a storage room containing confiscated equipment or RUAF weaponry.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: There are multiple possible locations for this key on Terminal, while only the one in the body of the dead RUAF soldier outside the armory building is guaranteed.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the armory inside the armory building on Terminal.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Confiscated player equipment in the equipment cabinets.
- Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence on the desk under the window. Note: Only spawns if the player brought it into the raid.
